control_room_rule.require: Explicit industrial SCADA/telemetry OR explicitly advertised salary >= 18000 ILS per month
control_room_rule.precedence: Excluded nontechnical/security/customer-service roles remain excluded even if salary is high. Unknown salary is not evidence that the salary threshold is met.

target_company_note: User preferences, not verified assertions about current funding, growth or compensation. Never override mandatory requirements.
score_policy: Use existing inspected and documented scoring formula. Without one, do not fabricate a numerical score or alter production ranking without approval.
insufficient_evidence_policy: NEEDS_REVIEW; no automatic shortlist inclusion until requirements and three distinct matches are evidenced.

schedule_intent.status: Imported intent only; verify actual workflow and DST behavior. Do not create schedule automatically.
